title: After Testing More Than 50 Pairs of Earbuds, I Finally Found My Favorite
summary: Apple AirPods Pro 3, Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen), and Shokz OpenDots 2 sounded bad by comparison. Using the Soundcore Balance or custom HearID profile, the Liberty 5 Pro sounds great.
